name: evidence-stack
title: Evidence Stack
description: A concise proof card that connects one claim to a measurable evidence point and source.
author: iPolloWork

ai.instructions: AI may summarize verified evidence and format a source label. It must not invent a statistic, citation, or testimonial.

variables.label: Evidence summary
variables.default: More reviewed ideas reached a decision

variables.label: Semantic cue times
variables.description: JSON event IDs to measured scene-relative seconds. Empty uses authored timings; this is not word alignment.

useWhen: Attach one measured figure and its source to one bounded claim.
avoidWhen: Do not fabricate a source, imply statistical significance or use an unsupported metric as proof.

inputRules.title: Supply real claim within the declared character limit. Do not substitute demo text.
inputRules.stat: One measured figure with unit/denominator when needed; do not fabricate or remove uncertainty.
inputRules.evidence: Describe the sample, scope and important qualifier without broadening the claim.
inputRules.source: A real source attribution whose reference can be checked in the storyboard; do not claim statistical confidence.

cueBindings.metric: When the corresponding narration clause begins: Reveal the measured figure. Use an actual measured scene-relative cue when available.
cueBindings.scope: When the corresponding narration clause begins: Explain the evidence scope. Use an actual measured scene-relative cue when available.
cueBindings.source: When the corresponding narration clause begins: Attach its actual source. Use an actual measured scene-relative cue when available.
cueBindings.resolve: At the concluding narration clause, settle the shown evidence; allow the authored final reading hold.

fallback.overflow: Split at a real semantic boundary or use a more suitable component; never truncate items or shrink text until unreadable.
fallback.missingInput: Report missing source/evidence or present a clearly qualified statement; never fabricate a metric or citation.
fallback.timingMismatch: Bind measured cueTimes once, preserving order, authored action durations and a 0.7–4s final hold. Split at a narration boundary when the sequence cannot fit; do not stretch speech or create a frozen tail.
fallback.inapplicable: Choose another validated recipe whose narrative job fits, split at a meaningful boundary, or report the library gap. Under recipes-only policy, never author custom graphics or force-fit content.

values.title: 走访收集到了哪些需求
values.evidence: 有效问卷数量，不能直接代表全部居民
values.source: 用户参考文档 · 走访调查

example.narration: 参考文档记录了六百二十四份有效问卷，这不能直接代表全部居民。

acceptance: Every active declared event changes its actual visible target; forward and backward seeking restore the same state.
The final state remains readable without cropped or overlapping important text, with honest source and timing metadata.
Read the claim → Read the measured figure → Read its scope and source → Hold claim and evidence together. Preserve this reading order and the source qualifiers.
Test Chinese content, the minimum and maximum supported item counts, and one rejected overflow or malformed input.
usage.intent: 让主张、数值和来源同时可见，使观众能判断证据是否真的支持结论。
